pr.title: Lock edits after 30 minutes
pr.body: Edits lock 30 minutes after an item is created; the item route answers **423** for a locked item. ### How it flows ![Request flow](/reviews/media/1f66ef59700c79fa583239afc1e04d4affdeef1e.png/e2e-token) - Minutes, not milliseconds - Owners can edit too

guide.overview: Edits lock 30 minutes after creation and the item route refuses locked edits.
guide.riskWhy: The lock now compares minutes, so existing items may lock sooner than before.

sections.title: Lock rule
sections.why: The lock compares minutes instead of raw milliseconds. Owners may edit too.
sections.explanation: The lock compares minutes instead of raw milliseconds. Owners may edit too.
